notes: Dev RBox expansion, paired with geography-replace-d006: gives the made-up relation cairn_bound_to (fictional, no property tags) the property the revision gives 'is the antipode of', asymmetry, applied to real places. Instance wording follows the revision: the direct question and second instance ask what the property allows or rules out (yes), the first instance whether the converse follows (no); zh asks the first instance and es the second. The pairs (Trondheim/Valparaiso, Hobart/Reykjavik) are arbitrary, so nothing real settles the converse, and the name has no built-in direction. Asymmetry is the edited property here, not a derivation (CRITERIA Rule 12 lists it as not used for derivations; the instance answers do change from 'no property' to a definite one; flagged as a spec note). Caveat: for an unknown relation the direct question and first instance have the same answers without the edit. hops counts the instance fact in the prompt as the bridge.
